recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中央一顆中型淋巴球，細胞質量多、淡藍色且邊緣不規則，形態接近大顆粒淋巴球（large granular lymphocyte）；但此倍率下看不清嗜天青顆粒，單張圖也無法證明淋巴球增多。
features: Single medium-sized lymphocyte with moderate N:C ratio
Round-to-slightly irregular nucleus with condensed chromatin
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm with irregular outline; azurophilic granules not resolvable at this magnification
Segmented neutrophil at the field edge for size comparison
Background normochromic red cells with scattered platelets
describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows normochromic, normocytic red cells with adequate platelets. A single medium-sized lymphocyte with condensed chromatin and a moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm is present centrally; cytoplasmic azurophilic granules cannot be resolved at this magnification. No blasts or atypical nucleolated cells are seen in this field. The image is compatible with a large granular lymphocyte in the setting of NK-cell lymphocytosis, but quantification and granule assessment require higher power and an absolute count, with flow cytometry to confirm NK phenotype.

ddx.vs: Morphologically identical LGLs; separation requires flow cytometry (surface CD3+, CD8+, CD57+ in T-LGL versus CD3-, CD16+/CD56+ in NK) and TCR clonality studies.
Reactive lymphocytes are larger with deeply basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around adjacent red cells and usually lack azurophilic granules.
Monocytes are larger with folded or lobulated nuclei, lacy chromatin, and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules.
